title: Alpine Macro王岩：四季度内地权益资产的结构性机会在哪？
speaker: Yang Wang

segments.en: So in terms of rotation, what are you looking and tilting towards to in the China equity market?
segments.zh: 那么在轮动方面，你在中国权益市场中关注和倾向哪些方向？

segments.en: Then if you're going overweight now in the fourth quarter, what could potentially be driving this market into the end of the year?
segments.zh: 如果你现在在第四季度增持，什么可能推动这个市场到年底？

segments.en: I think what we saw earlier, especially in the second quarter of this year, probably especially after the run-war, we can see the Chinese government really intentionally slowed down capital spending in infrastructure because we had positive surprise in Q1.
segments.zh: 我认为我们之前看到的，尤其是今年第二季度，可能特别是在那之后，我们可以看到中国政府确实有意放缓了基础设施的资本支出，因为我们在第一季度有积极的惊喜。

segments.en: And then probably Beijing was concerned that if they really increased spending in infrastructure, they would further push up cost pressure for companies.
segments.zh: 然后可能北京担心，如果他们真的增加基础设施支出，会进一步推高企业的成本压力。

segments.en: So I think like, so in Q4, I would expect some kind of capital intensive sectors to do better, especially they are coming from such a depressed starting point.
segments.zh: 所以我认为，在第四季度，我预计一些资本密集型板块会表现更好，尤其是它们来自如此低迷的起点。

segments.en: But also some other consumer sectors, consumer sectors, healthcare sectors, they were treating at very high multiples a few years ago. Now they have been completely washed out.
segments.zh: 但也有一些其他消费板块、医疗板块，几年前它们的估值倍数非常高。现在它们已经被完全洗出去了。

segments.en: So I think broadly speaking, we would expect a broad rally in the stock market, but some structure stories like consumer sector, healthcare sector were likely to do well.
segments.zh: 所以我认为总体而言，我们预计市场将广泛上涨，但一些结构性故事，如消费板块、医疗板块可能表现良好。

segments.en: And some very kept intensive sectors, material, commodity-related sectors were also probably to well.
segments.zh: 还有一些资本密集型板块，材料、大宗商品相关板块也可能表现良好。

segments.en: What about the potential for upside for financials out of EMs?
segments.zh: 那么新兴市场金融板块的上涨潜力如何？
